models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light easterlies and near-flat seas through tomorrow - Filicudi to Salina is a 15 nm motor-sail in under 5 kt.
briefing.synopsis: No organised pressure system in the payload - the picture is a slack, light-wind regime over the archipelago with the breeze boxing the compass between SSE and E at single-digit speeds. ECMWF IFS and AIFS (both 07 Oct 06Z) and ICON-2i (07 Oct 12Z) agree on 3-9 kt across the islands through tomorrow, with seas 0.4-0.9 ft. The one change on the horizon is late Thursday into Friday 9 Oct, when winds back through SW then N and MFWAM/ECMWF WAM (07 Oct 00Z/06Z) build total wave to around 2.0-2.3 ft with swell to 2.2 ft at Filicudi - worth noting now for the Salina-Portorosa leg.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight is Pecorini a Mare, and it is the recommendation only by a hair - Filicudi Porto scores 0.901 against Pecorini's 0.902, so the choice genuinely does not matter. Pecorini shows 4 kt SSE, gusts to 11 kt, swell 0.6 ft from the W; Filicudi Porto shows 5 kt ESE, gusts 9 kt, swell 0.5 ft NE. Both rate sheltered. Pecorini is open through the 109-269 sector, so if the southerly firms up overnight beyond what the models show, the short hop round to Filicudi Porto is the fallback.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Filicudi at 06:00 shows 3 kt from 169 degrees with 0.7 ft sea (model consensus, 07 Oct runs) - about as quiet as it gets. Recommended departure is 06:00 for the 15 nm run east to Salina, arriving around 08:00 in 3 kt SSE, gusts 10 kt, 0.7 ft sea on a close reach. The whole day is rated go, so the window is wide: every slot from 06:00 to 14:00 stays under 7 kt and 0.7 ft. Expect to motor from midday onward as the breeze goes E/ENE and the true wind angle collapses to 11-14 degrees.

passage_notes.note: Go all day. Best sailing is the early slots - 06:00 to 10:00, SSE/SE 3-4 kt, close reach to close hauled, seas 0.6-0.7 ft. From 12:00 the wind goes E then ENE and puts you head to wind: motor. Afternoon maxes at 6.3 kt ENE with 0.5 ft sea at 14:00.

Recommended 07:00 departure, deteriorating after 13:00. Thunderstorms are flagged in the 06:00 and 14:00 windows, which is what drives those two to no-go; the 08:00-12:00 slots rate go with N/NNW 4-10 kt and 1.8-2.0 ft sea on a run. Gust figures of 30-33 kt against 4-10 kt means are IFS interval-maximum values in light air, not a sustained forecast - but with convection in the picture, treat them as a signal to reef early. Portorosa Marina is enclosed, all-round shelter, 3 kt SSW on arrival.

cautions: Thunderstorms are forecast in the Salina-Portorosa passage windows on 09 Oct, early morning and from 14:00 - the two no-go verdicts. Plan on a 07:00-08:00 start and be alongside by early afternoon.

Several gust figures through the briefing (30.5, 32.9, 32.3 kt on the Portorosa leg; 25.9 kt at Filicudi overnight 09 Oct) are interval-maximum values from a single model against very light means. Reported, not a wind forecast - but they are large enough to knock a cat about if they verify.

Model spread exceeding 6 kt is flagged at a few hours: Filicudi 08 Oct 18:00 (4.0-12.6 kt), Filicudi 09 Oct 12:00 (3.5-12.4 kt), Lipari 09 Oct 00:00 (2.9-11.5 kt). Do not plan on the mean at those hours.
Seas build late on 09 Oct - Filicudi 2.3 ft total with 2.2 ft swell by 18:00 per MFWAM (07 Oct 00Z). Not a problem for the fleet, but the flat water ends Thursday.
briefing.confidence_note: IFS, AIFS and ICON-2i are closely aligned on the light-wind pattern through tomorrow, and run-to-run stability over the last 23 snapshots shows mean wind shifts of only 0.9-1.1 kt at 12-48 h lead; confidence drops for Friday's convective detail.
